market_view: Stress is rising: VIX up 8% in a day to 17.8, the 10-year yield at a new high of 4.94 on sticky August CPI and Fed-hike odds, and WTI jumped 6.7% in a day to 102.5 on Middle East supply attacks. Big moves cluster in this regime; stay selective.

oil_gas.reasoning: WTI +23% in 20 days and +6.7% in one day is already in the driver, yet XOM is only +0.7% in 5 days and 3.6% below its high. No dated XOM catalyst; yesterday's driver move does not predict the stock. Rate-hike risk adds variance.

gold_miners.reasoning: Yields at a high, Fed-hike odds rising, gold below its 200-day average and near a one-month low. Headlines are restatements of price. No concrete reason for a long; the Fed vote next week adds variance.

chips.reasoning: NVDA -2.4% on the day, sector ETF -2.4%. Headlines (TSMC record sales, Anthropic IPO backing talk, HBM shortage) are known or noisy; no dated NVDA catalyst. A rising-rate shock hits long-duration stocks.

pharma.reasoning: LLY -8% in 20 days with no LLY-specific news; headlines are generic FDA and Medicare items. A weak sector link means no driver reason. Nothing concrete to name for a long.

copper_uranium.reasoning: Copper -5% in one day and FCX -6.6%, with a Trefis headline about a tariff doubt but no clear cause or reversal reason. Do not guess a rebound in a stress regime.

would_change_my_mind: A dated, named catalyst for one leader (company event, policy decision, or confirmed supply shock not yet in the stock price) with a calm VIX.

handoff.what_changed: WTI jumped 6.7% in a day to 102.5 (Brent 107.6) after Saudi East-West pipeline attacks, while XOM barely moved. The 10-year yield reached 4.94 on sticky August CPI with a Fed hike vote next week, and VIX rose to 17.8. Copper fell 5% in a day (FCX -6.6%) and NVDA slipped 2.4%.

oil_gas.why: The oil spike is in the driver and XOM has not followed; no dated XOM catalyst.

gold_miners.why: Yields at a high and Fed-hike odds rising; no concrete reason for a long.

chips.why: Headlines are known or noisy and there is no dated NVDA catalyst.

pharma.why: No LLY-specific news; generic FDA and Medicare headlines only.

copper_uranium.why: The one-day drop has no clear cause; no rebound guess in a stress regime.
